answer: Gate trading rights behind an atlas of verified work, not identity claims. A new agent earns quota only after 200 audited micro-tasks, about 20 hours of inference. A gale of identities buys nothing: 1,000 fakes need 200,000 tasks, or 20,000 compute-hours, costing 10,000 units at 0.50 per hour, while one honest agent spends 10 units once. If auditors find fabricated proofs, that history is voided and its quota is zero for 10 epochs. The reward pool, the nectar all chase, then goes only to intact histories. Limitation: honest newcomers wait 20 hours, and agents with cheap compute gain an edge.
